algebra_derivation.premises: Kähler curvature symmetries R(i,bar j,k,bar l)=R(k,bar j,i,bar l)=R(i,bar l,k,bar j), Hermitian conjugation, and R(1,bar2,p,bar q)=0 for all ambient p,q. These last zeros remain conditional on the valid reaction/minimum step, not proved by this algebra alone.
algebra_derivation.mixed_vanishing: Hermitian conjugation gives R(2,bar1,p,bar q)=0. For any tuple i,j,k,l in{1,2} not all equal, separate permutations of the two unbarred and two barred positions can make the first unbarred and barred indices unequal: otherwise every unbarred entry equals every barred entry, forcing all four equal. Kähler symmetries therefore reduce every one of the14mixed entries to a known zero. No extra first-variation identities are needed for this restricted two-plane expansion once the whole cross slice vanishes.
algebra_derivation.rotation: For v=(e1+e2)/sqrt2 and w=(e1-e2)/sqrt2, multilinearity and the14mixed zeros give R(v,bar v,w,bar w)=(H(e1)+H(e2))/4. With positive sectional terms this contradicts parallel/U(d)-holonomy invariance of zero pairs. This matches the paid Gu/Cao-Chen-Zhu mechanism.
algebra_derivation.nonorthogonal_pairs: Under the full ordered-pair null-transport premise, U(d-1) stabilizer averaging at X removes mixed terms from Y=aX+bZ and gives a²H(X)+b²/(d-1)sum_j R(X,barX,e_j,bar e_j)=0. Nonnegativity and H(X)>0 force a=0; d=1 is collinear. A theorem about orthonormal pairs alone would not supply this premise.

assessment: The local Prop1 statement permits compact-coordinate/path localization after the requisite parabolic inequality is supplied on the full ordered-pair bundle. Survey proof explicitly works with all2vectors, while Brendle-Schoen Prop2 is phrased for orthonormal k-frames; direct use of Prop1 is needed for this interface. Source preliminaries explicitly does not require ψ or immersion properness, and strict curvature occurs in its initial Busemann construction; the inspected subsequent interpolation uses strictψ plus nonnegative coefficient curvature. No conclusion about unread flow/disc bodies follows.
